quantization: Q4_K_M (GGUF via llama.cpp / vLLM HTTP API)
system_prompt: You are an expert roboticist inspecting segmented 3D map entities. Analyze the provided object image crop. Determine its semantic category, its physical affordance (FIXED: permanently attached fixture; PORTABLE: relocatable freestanding object; MOBILE_AGENT: active dynamic actor), and its physical support relation. Return structured JSON.
keying_contract: All responses keyed strictly by globally unique candidate_id (dataset_id + sequence_id + session_id + physical_entity_id + track_id).
